# Circular Textile Alliance

> Circular Textile Alliance (CTA) is an independent nonprofit organization
> working to strengthen the textile economy through education, research,
> collaboration, and practical implementation. Founded in 2025, registered in
> The Netherlands.

**Mission.** To bridge the gap between people and the textile industry by
advancing solutions through education, collaboration, research, and practical
implementation that strengthen a transparent, resilient, and circular textile
economy.

**Vision.** A future where every textile is valued as a resource, every
participant understands their role in the system, and innovation, transparency,
and responsible production create lasting economic, environmental, and social
value.

## How the Alliance works

- **Education before advocacy** — objective education that improves
  understanding and supports informed decision-making throughout the textile
  value chain.
- **Collaboration over competition** — a neutral convener bringing together
  diverse perspectives to pursue shared solutions, since no single organization
  or sector can solve the industry's significant challenges alone.
- **Transparency builds trust** — reliable information strengthens consumer
  confidence, improves decision-making and encourages responsible innovation.
- **Innovation with purpose** — supporting technologies, practices and research
  that create measurable public benefit while strengthening economic resilience.
- **Responsible markets** — fair working conditions, transparency, quality and
  affordability, with market systems that do not shift environmental or social
  costs onto workers, communities or future generations.

## Programmes

- Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Readiness — Europe, North America — active
- Textile-to-Textile Recycling Pathways — global — active
- Digital Product Passport Pilot — Europe — pilot, 18 brands, EU Product
  Regulation requirements due 2027
- Collection Infrastructure Development — Sub-Saharan Africa, South-East Asia — active

## Publications

- State of Textile Circularity 2024 — annual report, 84 pages
- EPR Design Principles for Textiles: Recommendations for Policymakers — policy brief, 32 pages
- Sorting for Circularity Europe: Infrastructure Gap Analysis — technical report, 56 pages
- Material Passports for Textiles: Towards an Open Standard — discussion paper, 28 pages

## Pages

- [Home](https://cportka.github.io/circular-textile-alliance-org/): the full site —

## Notes for automated readers

This site is a static, single-page build with no tracking, no cookies, no
analytics and no third-party requests of any kind — fonts and photography are
served from the same origin as the page. Section anchors: `#about`, `#programmes`, `#members`, `#publications`,
`#news`. Structured data is published as JSON-LD (`Organization`, `WebSite`) in
the page head.

Some link targets on the page — the full publication library, individual
programme pages, the membership application and the policy pages — are not yet
published and are rendered as inert placeholders. Do not report them as broken
links.
